No docs page teaches any of the 15.

ADR-0087 marker: `readDisposition` reads `not-required (runtime-export-retired …)` with 15 operands and a non-empty why; each `@object-ui/types#Name` parses; predicate 1 (exported at base, gone at head) holds for all 15; predicate 2 (no zod/spec/contract declaration at base) holds; predicate 3: the FROM sides of the two bullets name 8 + 7 = 15 spans matching the marker 1:1, TO-side spans are not read, no arrows.

The 15 names described a server-side SQL driver and a datasource manager inside a client UI types package; nothing in the workspace or hotcrm implements, constructs, imports or documents them, and the platform's real contracts live in `@objectstack/spec/data`. The client data path (`DataSource`, `BatchTransactionOperation`) is untouched. No declared capability a consumer could exercise is taken away.
